question_text: Passage: 'Despite the city's efforts to improve traffic flow, congestion has worsened over the past year. The number of registered vehicles increased by 15%, while road capacity grew by only 3%.' What can be inferred?

options.text: Road capacity increased faster than vehicles.
The city did nothing about traffic.

hint_ladder.title: Spot the Key Numbers
hint_ladder.text: Look at the two percentages in the passage. One is about vehicles, the other about road capacity. Which one is bigger?

hint_ladder.title: The Simple Rule for Inferences
hint_ladder.text: An inference is a logical conclusion based on facts given. You don't guess or predict the future. You just connect the dots from what's already there.

hint_ladder.title: Connect the Dots
hint_ladder.text: Vehicles up 15%, roads up 3% means more cars, little extra space. So what does that tell you about vehicle vs. road growth?

hint_ladder.title: Almost There
hint_ladder.text: The correct answer is the one that says vehicles grew faster than roads could keep up. Look for the option that matches that idea exactly.

A.text: You might have chosen A because you assumed the effort would eventually pay off, but future predictions aren't inferences from given data.

B.text: You might have chosen B because you flipped the numbers, but 15% growth in vehicles is clearly larger than 3% in road capacity.

C.text: Correct. Vehicle growth of 15% outpaced the small 3% increase in road capacity, leading to worse congestion.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you missed the phrase 'despite the city's efforts,' which shows they did take action.

next_time_rule: Sa inference, facts lang gamitin. Walang hula. Tanong: 'Alin ang mas mabilis?' dito. Pagkumpara, sagot agad.
deconstruct_text:
Tara! Isipin mo sa EDSA: sasakyan dumami 15%, pero kalsada lumawak lang 3%. Mas marami ang sasakyan kaysa dagdag na kalsada. Kaya tamang inference: **C: Vehicle growth outpaced road infrastructure**.

Wag malito: A—future? Wala tayong data; B—baligtad numbers; D—may 'despite the city's efforts' naman. Mental trick: 'Alin ang mas mabilis?' Dito, sasakyan ang mas mabilis dumami, kalsada mabagal, kaya outpace. Easy!
